editorial:
Imagine losing your high-paying job and your fancy life all at once. That is exactly where you find Brian, a guy who just cannot let go of his rich lifestyle. To get his money back, he makes a huge mistake by jumping into a drug deal. Things go from bad to worse when two kids accidentally steal the cash from his car. You get to watch these three different worlds crash into each other in a messy way. The movie feels like a ticking time bomb because Brian is stuck between some scary criminals and the kids who have his money. It is a gritty story about what happens when greed takes over and you make a choice you cannot take back.

Luke Goss does a great job playing a man who is slowly losing his mind. The pacing is quick, and the tension stays high throughout the film. While some of the plot twists feel a bit predictable, the acting keeps you interested. If you love stories about bad decisions leading to total chaos, you will enjoy this one. You can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a sharp picture, or you might want to rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical shelf is a great way to own this tense ride.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the different groups finally meet. Brian tries to get the money back to save his own skin, but the greed of everyone involved leads to a bloody finish. After a series of betrayals and violence, most of the characters end up dead. The twist is that the money brings nothing but misery. In the end, the cycle of crime wipes out almost everyone, showing that the quick fix was actually a death sentence.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime thrillers and stories about people making terrible life choices.
